definitions: An out-of-place artifact; an object of historical, archaeological, or paleontological interest that is found in a very unusual or seemingly impossible context, often suggesting a level of technological advancement or knowledge that is inconsistent with the known capabilities of the historical period in which it was supposedly made.
examples: The discovery of the Antikythera Mechanism is often cited as a prime example of an Oopart.
Many alleged Ooparts are later explained by conventional archaeology or geology.
The museum featured a display dedicated to various Ooparts from around the world.
